item.title: Paine College president highlights enrollment goals, grants in State of the College
item.description: Paine College President Dr. Lester A. McCorn delivered his State of the College address Wednesday at the Gilbert-Lambuth Memorial Chapel. The post Paine College president highlights enrollment goals, grants in State of the College appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Mayor to deliver ‘State of the City’ address Thursday
item.description: Mayor Garnett Johnson will deliver his 2026 State of the City address Thursday during a meeting of the Exchange Club of Augusta. The post Mayor to deliver ‘State of the City’ address Thursday appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Board overturns Augusta procurement official’s firing
item.description: Augusta’s interim procurement director for 11 months is getting a second chance to keep his city job after appealing to the personnel board. The post Board overturns Augusta procurement official’s firing appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County passes two out of three rezonings for data center requests amid persistent opposition
item.description: Some 17 speakers out of a packed house spoke before the Columbia County Board of Commissioners (BOC), Tuesday night, to urge the county to deny three rezoning requests for data center developments in District 4. The post Columbia County passes two out of three rezonings for data center requests amid persistent opposition appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Josey High principal arrested for simple battery against employee
item.description: Dr. Derrias Priestley, principal of T.W. Josey High School, surrendered on Wednesday on a charge of "simple battery against a public employee." The post Josey High principal arrested for simple battery against employee appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Pepper ball used to de-escalate situation inside Richmond County jail
item.description: A tense confrontation inside the Charles B. Webster Detention Center prompted a deputy to deploy a less-lethal pepper ball Thursday afternoon after several inmates refused lockdown orders and surrounded the officer, according to the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office. The post Pepper ball used to de-escalate situation inside Richmond County jail appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Aiken bicyclist dies following collision with truck
item.description: A bicyclist was hit and killed Tuesday night in Aiken following a collision with a pickup truck, according to Aiken County Coroner Darryl Ables. The post Aiken bicyclist dies following collision with truck appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County records first homicide with stabbing at Augusta State Medical Prison
item.description: An inmate at Augusta State Medical Prison was stabbed to death on Jan. 20 in an incident reportedly triggered by a dispute over a commissary debt, a killing that has gone unannounced by Georgia prison officials. The post Columbia County records first homicide with stabbing at Augusta State Medical Prison appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County Planning staff presents review for 2025
item.description: Columbia County received fewer rezoning requests in 2025 than in the four preceding years, the planning department has found. The post Columbia County Planning staff presents review for 2025 appeared first on The Augusta Press.
